programmes.evidence: Current official KIT department doctoral page allows research doctorates in all its research fields through institute supervision and names the two alternative research credentials. The official Institute for Operations Research profile establishes substantive OR, supply-chain and logistics research and its KIT department relationship. This is one broad supervised OR pathway with alternative qualification options, not two separately listed degree routes.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official research doctorate requires an independent original dissertation; the German original also names Dr. rer. pol. or Dr.-Ing. and institute-supervised work in all department teaching/research fields.

limitations: Programme is a broad supervised doctoral pathway rather than a separately titled Operations Research award; two possible credentials are alternative outcomes of the same documented institute-hosted route.
No founding year, current intake guarantee or historical graduate credential inferred.
Wider business and engineering doctoral inventories remain incomplete; KIT Service Research training is not an independent award.

branches.conclusion: Current KIT Department of Business and Economics research-doctorate route and Institute for Operations Research host verified. Other institutes and exact broader doctoral field inventory remain unchecked.

Current KIT department permits Dr.-Ing. as an alternative research doctorate at an institute, but separate engineering college/faculty doctoral inventories are not exhaustively checked. No extra independent route inferred.
